tha-ap22:1.1: {Sumaṅgala}.] Āhutiṃ yiṭṭhukāmo 'haṃ paṭiyādetvāna bhojanaṃ / brāhmaṇe paṭimānento visāle mālake ṭhito. // //
tha-ap22:2.1: Ath' addasāsiṃ sambu*ddhaṃ Piyadassiṃ* mahāyasaṃ / sabbalokavinetāraṃ sayambhuṃ aggapuggalaṃ. // //
tha-ap22:3.1: Bhagavantaṃ jutimantaṃ sāvakehi purakkhataṃ / ādiccam iva rocantaṃ rathiyaṃ pavisantakaṃ. // //
tha-ap22:4.1: Añjalim paggahetvāna sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ / manasā 'va nimantesiṃ: *‘āgacchatu* mahāmuni.' // //
tha-ap22:5.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro / khīṇāsavasahassehi mama dvāraṃ upāgami // //
tha-ap22:6.1: ‘Namo te purisājañña namo te purisuttama! / pāsādaṃ abhirūhitvā sīhāsane nisīda tvaṃ.' // //
tha-ap22:7.1: Danto danta*parivāro tiṇṇo* tārayataṃ varo / pāsādaṃ abhirūhitvā nisīdi pavarāsane. // //
tha-ap22:8.1: Yam me atthi sake gehe āmisaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ / tāhaṃ buddhassa pādāsiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi. // //
tha-ap22:9.1: Pasannacitto sumano vedajāto kata*ñjalī / Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ nama*ssāmi: ‘aho buddhass' uḷāratā. // //
tha-ap22:10.1: Aṭṭhannaṃ payirupāsataṃ bhuñjaṃ khīṇāsavā bahū / tuyh' ev' eso ānubhāvo saraṇan taṃ upem' ahaṃ'. // //
tha-ap22:11.1: Piyadassī ca bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap22:12.1: "Yo so saṅghaṃ abhojesi ujubhūtaṃ samāhitaṃ / Tathāgataṃ ca sambuddhaṃ suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap22:13.1: Sattavīsatikkhattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati / sakakammābhiraddho so devaloke ramissati. // //
tha-ap22:14.1: Dasañ c' aṭṭhañ ca kkhattuṃ so cakkavatti bhavissati / pathavyā rajjaṃ pañcasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati". // //
tha-ap22:15.1: Araññaṃ vanam ogayha kānanaṃ vyagghasevitaṃ / padhānapadahitvāna kilesā jhāpitā mayā. // //
tha-ap22:16.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhattadānass idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap22:17.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap22:18.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sumaṅgalo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
tha-ap22:21.1: Sīhāsanī Ekatthambhī Nando ca Culla-Panthako Pilindo Rāhulo ceva Vaṅganto Raṭṭhapālako.
tha-ap22:22.1: Sopāko Maṅgalo c' eva dase ca dutiye vagge satañ ca sattatiṃsā ca gāthā c' ettha pakāsitā.
